optimizer_policy: Both arms reset AdamW equally; no mid-run resume. Same seed/data/crop sequence, learning rate, reconstruction objective and two additional epochs. Treatment adds raw reference identity L1 weight 0.5, requiring an extra reference forward/backward contribution.
compute_budget: Reuse the completed 714-step control and its diagnostic40 evaluation without rewriting prior artifacts. Train exactly one new centered-identity arm: 2 epochs / 714 additional updates. 40 new enhancement evaluations plus 12 native reference identity checks (six per arm), no selection/final inputs.
interpretation: Exploratory follow-up using the same diagnostic data. Compare against reused no-identity control and prior full identity treatment. No automatic winner or release approval. Centering also changes effective loss magnitude, so this does not isolate gradient direction independently of strength.
full_model_comparison: Any retained final setting requires an explicit controlled RGB/depth protocol, including correctly aligned depth for reference identity inputs if used in a depth model. This RGB-only pilot does not establish that comparison.
rationale: Post-hoc inspection of five largest full-identity regressions shows reduced correction RMS and increased mean RGB bias; mean-centered reference residual L1 removes the penalty on uniform per-channel reference shifts while retaining a penalty on spatially varying changes.
pilot_continuation_criteria: Both diagnostic mean PSNR and SSIM must be at least the matched control values for a positive continuation signal.
Mean centered absolute reference identity change on the fixed six must decrease versus control.
Inspect the fixed prior five worst regressions plus 380/729/851 for colour, detail and contours; no new major visual defect. This is not independent artifact approval.
If any criterion fails, do not promote or automatically sweep more weights. A positive signal still requires a separately declared full baseline protocol and formal selection/artifact review.
cumulative_budget: This diagnostic cycle now has three declared distinct settings: no identity, full reference identity weight0.5, centered reference identity weight0.5. Exactly one new arm is authorized by this protocol; no seed or weight sweep.
